VisiMisi.title: Vision & Mission
VisiMisi.subtitle: The foundation and direction of the BEM STMIK Tazkia Cabinet in bringing positive change to the STMIK Tazkia academic community.
VisiMisi.visiText: To establish BEM STMIK Tazkia as an initiator of progressive, inclusive, and impactful movements for the academic community and society based on information technology.
VisiMisi.misi0: Optimize responsive and solution-oriented student advocacy services.
VisiMisi.misi1: Build a space for critical and innovative intellectual dialogue in technology.
VisiMisi.misi2: Align student movements with strategic national digitalization issues.

home.welcome_desc: This is the official portal of BEM STMIK Tazkia. Here you can see the latest information about campus life and student innovation projects.
home.innovation_desc: In this section, you can view the showcase of the best works from STMIK Tazkia students. You can also upload your own project!
home.news_desc: Don't miss out on information! All the latest news, achievements, and important announcements are here.
home.live_desc: Here you can see events happening today in real-time. Don't miss out!
home.upcoming_desc: Check the upcoming BEM activity schedule so you can prepare yourself to participate.
home.volunteer_desc: BEM often opens open recruitment for committees. This is your chance to join as a volunteer!
home.archive_desc: View the gallery and documentation from exciting events that have been held previously.
home.voice_desc: Have a suggestion, complaint, or brilliant idea? Share it anonymously through this aspiration box.
home.login_desc: Log in with your campus email to start uploading projects, registering for events, and viewing your activity history. Start your journey now!

karya.header_desc: This page is a digital showcase where all the projects, research, and best innovations from STMIK Tazkia students are gathered.
karya.cta_desc: Have a cool project? Don't keep it to yourself! Click this button to upload and showcase your work to the entire campus. (Login required)
karya.filter_desc: Use these buttons to filter projects by a specific field, such as Web Apps, Mobile, or IoT.
karya.search_desc: Or use this field if you want to search for a specific project title or creator name.

agenda.header_desc: Welcome to the BEM STMIK Tazkia event information center! Find various exciting and beneficial activities here.
agenda.nav_desc: Use this menu to switch between the regular Agenda/Events list and Open Recruitment or Volunteer vacancy information.
agenda.search_desc: Type an event name or keyword here to quickly find the activity you're looking for.
agenda.filter_desc: Click this category to filter the type of activity, for example specifically Technology, Sports, or Arts & Culture.
agenda.calendar_desc: View the activity schedule visually for a month. You can also click on a marked date to see the event details directly!

berita.header_desc: This page is the official BEM information center. You can read various articles, press releases, and the latest news from campus here.
berita.search_desc: Use the search field or click an available category to find the article most relevant to your interests.
berita.featured_desc: This is the most important current article or announcement that is the main spotlight from BEM.
berita.grid_desc: Here you can browse all the latest publications. Click on any news card to read the full article.
berita.popular_desc: A list of articles that have been most read and liked by other students will appear in this column.

mahasiswa.header_desc: Welcome to the Student Directory page! Here you can search for the profiles of STMIK Tazkia friends along with their project portfolios.
mahasiswa.stats_desc: A summary of the total registered students, the number of uploaded projects, and the number of batches currently in the system.
mahasiswa.search_desc: Type a name, student ID, skill, or project title to find students quickly.
mahasiswa.filter_desc: Use these buttons to filter the student list by a specific year of entry or study program.

kabinet.header_desc: Welcome to the BEM Profile page! Get to know more about the cabinet name and the movers of BEM STMIK Tazkia for this period.
kabinet.vision_desc: Here you can read the Vision and Mission that form the foundation of our cabinet's struggle for one period of administration.
kabinet.board_desc: Get to know the faces of the Core Board (President, Vice, Secretary, and Treasurer). You can also contact them directly via the available social media buttons!
kabinet.proker_desc: This is a list of large-scale flagship work programs held directly under the direction of the BEM Core Board.
kabinet.dept_desc: Explore each existing department. You can click the 'Members' or 'Work Programs' tab on each card to see more details.

dokumentasi.header_desc: Welcome to the memory room! All photos and activity documentation from BEM STMIK Tazkia are neatly stored on this page.
dokumentasi.search_desc: Use the category buttons to filter the type of activity, or type a specific event name in this search field.
dokumentasi.grid_desc: Click on one of these albums (cards) to see the full photo collection of that event. The number of photos is shown in the top right corner of the card.
